newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end slightly firmer in slack trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end slightly firmer in slack trade.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Swiss franc bonds ended slightly firmer in a friendly market, but trading was slack. "Something incredible has to happen for the market to return to life," a dealer said.
March Conf-future rose seven points to 115.65 percent, but only 784 contracts traded. Average yield on government debt fell two points to 3.68 percent. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
